planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in moist, acidic, well-drained soil in partial shade to morning sun; Bloom-A-Thon azaleas rebloom continuously from spring through fall rather than in a few discrete flushes, and tolerate more sun than most traditional azaleas.

directions: Plant in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade to morning sun, though this series tolerates considerably more direct sun than older azalea types once established. Bloom-A-Thon is a breeding series developed as an alternative to the Encore line, valued for a more continuous rebloom pattern through the growing season rather than distinct spring, summer, and fall flushes, along with a naturally more compact, mounded habit that needs little pruning to stay tidy. Cultivars are available across a range of flower colors including hot pink, lavender, red, and white, all sharing strong heat tolerance and repeat flowering suited to long Gulf South growing seasons. Water deeply during dry spells to support the extended bloom cycle, and prune lightly right after the heaviest spring flush to shape the plant without removing developing buds for later color.
